Title: Le Mans Rooftop Ventilator
Body (HTML):
The Le Mans is where style meets raw airflow. A sleek, low-profile cover (only 64 mm above the roof, so it sits happily next to solar panels) hides a motor that moves 850 m³/h in either direction: suck hot, humid or contaminated air out, or blow fresh air in. It is the ventilator that bodybuilders across Europe specify when a vehicle simply has to stay fresh.

Choose 12V for vans, campers and passenger vehicles, or 24V for trucks, coaches and buses. Both versions are EMC approved, so they will not interfere with your vehicle electronics. Prefer a passive solution? The motorless version uses the same 230 mm roof cut-out and can be upgraded to electric later.

Finish the installation with a 3-way switch (blow / off / suck), an optional speed controller and one of our interior valves or grilles. Everything fits the same 230 mm opening.

Key features

  • 850 m³/h airflow, suction and blowing
  • 12V or 24V motor, 80 W, 2600 rpm
  • Only 52 dB(A) at full speed, quieter with speed control
  • Low profile: 64 mm above the roof, 385 x 312 mm footprint
  • Streamlined ABS roof ring with PA6 cover, 1.3 kg
  • Roof opening 230 mm (245 mm with ring)
